answer: Each agent identity must lock a stake equal to 0.1 ETH times the square of its ordinal index, so the 1st fake identity costs 0.1 ETH but the 10th costs 10 ETH—a quadratic fee curve that makes bulk Sybil forging on any island of the agent economy economically prohibitive. Identities also receive a unique on-chain pigment hash of their attestation history; if 3 peers flag the hash as forged within 2 epochs, the entire stake is slashed.
